description.fun: Larvitar is born deep underground, far from its parents, and after digging to the surface it grows by eating soil, becoming Pupitar once it has eaten a whole mountain's worth. It doesn't like bright light. Sleeping Larvitar have been found clutching a half-eaten clump of earth, apparently having dozed off on a full stomach.
description.guide: A small Rock- and Ground-type Pokémon that is born underground and grows by eating soil. It lives in mountains and caves and dislikes bright light. It evolves into Pupitar at level 30 and Tyranitar at level 55.
description.tagline: A rock-skinned baby kaiju that eats a mountain to grow up

description.fun: Pupitar is the pupa stage of a dinosaur, an odd idea since it's insects that have one, sealed in a shell as hard as bedrock while its limbs grow inside. To get around it blasts out compressed gas with enough force to knock down a mountain, and it keeps rocketing about even in its sleep.
description.guide: A Rock- and Ground-type Pokémon, the middle stage of the Larvitar line, enclosed in a very hard shell while its limbs develop. It propels itself with blasts of compressed gas. It evolves into Tyranitar at level 55.
description.tagline: A bedrock-hard cocoon that jets around on compressed gas

description.fun: Tyranitar is a walking kaiju: when it rages it sets off earthquakes that flatten mountains and bury rivers, so mapmakers have to redraw their maps. It's arrogant, always looking for a fight yet ignoring foes it thinks aren't worth its time, and it sleeps sprawled out, unbothered by anything. It closely resembles a monster Ken Sugimori drew for a magazine in 1997, which he said was unrelated to Pokémon.
description.guide: A large Rock- and Dark-type dinosaur Pokémon, the final form of Larvitar, with armour-like hide and enormous strength. Its rampages can reshape the landscape. It can Mega Evolve into Mega Tyranitar, and the Paradox Pokémon Iron Thorns is said to be a future relative.
description.tagline: A kaiju that redraws the map whenever it loses its temper

description.fun: Mega Evolution floods Tyranitar with so much power that its back splits open and its belly scales glow red with energy, like an insect bursting from a cocoon. Its instincts grow so destructive that it may not even hear its Trainer's orders.
